dataNote: Illustrative demo thresholds, not adopted agency policy.

levels.trigger: NWS advisory in effect, snow 1–2.9 in, or wind chill −1 to −9°F
levels.basis: NWS CAP severity; agency occupant emergency plan

levels.trigger: Ice ≥ 0.05 in or snow 3–5.9 in ending before 7 AM, with roads improving by 10 AM
levels.basis: MoDOT road-condition categories; OPM delayed-arrival status

levels.trigger: Warning-level hazard starting during office hours: ≥ 2 in snow or any ice before 5 PM
levels.basis: NWS warning onset time; evening commute window

levels.trigger: Wind chill ≤ −20°F during the morning commute while roads stay passable
levels.basis: NWS cold-weather warning criteria; OPM unscheduled leave and telework option

levels.trigger: NWS Winter Storm, Ice Storm, or Blizzard Warning through the workday, snow ≥ 6 in, ice ≥ 0.25 in, or roads covered
levels.basis: NWS warning taxonomy; OPM closure status; agency continuity plan

sources.title: CAP alert fields
sources.detail: Severity, certainty, and urgency provide structured, nationally consistent hazard screening.

sources.title: Road-condition categories
sources.detail: Clear, partly covered, and covered road reports decide whether employees can commute safely.

sources.title: Dismissal and closure procedures
sources.detail: Operating statuses, telework expectations, and weather and safety leave follow governmentwide guidance.
